danone-precision-probiotics.title: Precision Probiotics.
danone-precision-probiotics.description: Developing a custom triplex qPCR kit to quantify proprietary strains in finished yogurt products.
danone-precision-probiotics.challenge: Our partner required a faster and more precise method to quantify proprietary probiotic strains directly in finished yogurt products. Conventional plating methods were too slow and lacked the specificity needed to distinguish closely related strains, creating delays in product release.
danone-precision-probiotics.solution: With the MILA™ AI platform, TAAG designed a custom triplex qPCR assay targeting proprietary genetic signatures of the three probiotic strains. The result was a single-reaction quantitative method capable of differentiating closely related strains and delivering actionable results in just 3 hours.
results: Quantification time reduced from days to under 3 hours.
100% strain specificity achieved in complex dairy matrices.
Seamless integration into their existing laboratory workflows.

arca-continental-bottling-intelligence.company: One of the world’s leading bottling companies
arca-continental-bottling-intelligence.title: Bottling Intelligence.
arca-continental-bottling-intelligence.description: Standardizing microbiological control across 35 production plants with our AI-driven software.
arca-continental-bottling-intelligence.challenge: Managing microbiological data across 35 different bottling plants created information silos. Quality managers lacked real-time visibility to trace contamination sources and predict risk across the entire supply chain efficiently.
arca-continental-bottling-intelligence.solution:
We implemented the TxA™ platform to centralize microbiological data and deployed AI algorithms for predictive risk assessment and plant mapping. Our partner is expanding the use of TxA as a core component of its microbiological control strategy.

Following successful implementation, the partner plans to deploy TxA across all 35 production plants, standardizing data, accelerating decision-making, and strengthening preventive control at scale.
results: Standardized quality control metrics across all international facilities.
Real-time alerts for contamination trends before they reach critical levels.
Significant reduction in delayed product releases.

fast-salmonella-food.title: Fast control of Salmonella in the food industry
fast-salmonella-food.description: Achieve actionable results and product release in just 9 hours, bypassing 24-48h enrichments.
fast-salmonella-food.challenge: Traditional food testing for Salmonella can take up to 24 to 48 hours, causing massive warehousing bottlenecks, delaying product release, and reducing shelf life. Furthermore, thermal or chemical interventions often leave dead cells that cause costly false positives in standard DNA tests.
fast-salmonella-food.solution: Powered by our revolutionary AiGOR technology, this solution targets metabolically active RNA to detect Salmonella in complex food matrices in a fraction of the time. It differentiates live cells from dead ones seamlessly.
results: Same-Day Positive Release: Cut holding times drastically with results in just 9 hours.
Live Cell Differentiation: RNA-based detection avoids false positives caused by dead cells.
Complex Matrix Ready: Highly robust against inhibitors found in chocolate related matrices.
Maximum Sensitivity: Consistently detect down to 1 CFU/sample.

full-preventive-control.title: Preventive Control in a Single Reaction.
full-preventive-control.description: Helping a food manufacturer move from reactive pathogen testing to integrated preventive microbiological control with results in approximately 24 hours.
full-preventive-control.challenge: Our partner needed to strengthen microbiological control without increasing laboratory complexity. Their existing workflow required separate tests for pathogens and hygiene indicators, increasing cost, labor, and turnaround time. More importantly, pathogen results only confirmed problems after contamination risk had already materialized.
full-preventive-control.solution: TAAG deployed an integrated multiplex PCR approach that simultaneously detects Salmonella, L. monocytogenes, and key hygiene indicator microorganisms in a single reaction tube. By combining pathogen detection and indicator monitoring into one workflow, the partner gained a faster and more actionable view of microbiological risk, with results available in approximately 24 hours.
results: Combined pathogen and hygiene indicator detection in one PCR reaction.
Results available in approximately 24 hours to support faster release and corrective decisions.
Earlier visibility of hygiene failures and contamination risk signals.
Lower operational burden by reducing separate assays, reagents, plasticware, and hands-on time.
A more preventive quality control model with simplified implementation across routine testing.

broad-spectrum-spoilage.title: Broad-Spectrum Spoilage Defense.
broad-spectrum-spoilage.description: Helping a beverage manufacturer accelerate spoilage screening and protect product quality with broad-spectrum molecular detection.
broad-spectrum-spoilage.challenge: Our partner needed a faster and more comprehensive way to control spoilage risk in finished beverages. Traditional plating methods required 5 to 7 days and provided limited visibility while products waited for release. This delay increased inventory pressure, slowed distribution, and left the brand exposed to quality failures such as package swelling, turbidity, off-flavors, and premature shelf-life loss.
broad-spectrum-spoilage.solution: TAAG implemented a high-capacity multiplex PCR solution to detect the most relevant beverage spoilage microorganisms in a single molecular workflow, including acidophilic bacteria, yeasts, molds, and preservative-resistant yeasts. This allowed the partner to identify spoilage risks before they compromised product quality, reducing dependency on slow culture-based methods and enabling faster release decisions.
results: Reduced spoilage screening time from 5–7 days to around 50 hours.
Broad detection of critical beverage spoilers, including acidophilic bacteria, yeasts, molds, and preservative-resistant yeasts.
Earlier identification of microorganisms associated with package swelling, turbidity, off-flavors, and shelf-life failures.
Consolidated multiple culture-based tests into a simplified molecular workflow.
Stronger quality control decisions before product distribution.

salmonella-ecoli-protection.title: Protection against Salmonella and E. coli
salmonella-ecoli-protection.description: Simultaneous multiplex detection of Salmonella, E. coli O157:H7, and STEC.
salmonella-ecoli-protection.challenge: Our partner needed to accelerate pathogen testing for highly perishable products without compromising food safety. Their existing workflow required separate protocols for Salmonella, E. coli O157:H7, and STEC, increasing laboratory complexity, turnaround time, and release delays for products such as leafy greens.
salmonella-ecoli-protection.solution: TAAG implemented a multiplex PCR solution capable of detecting Salmonella, E. coli O157:H7, and STEC from a single enriched sample. By consolidating three critical pathogen tests into one molecular workflow, the partner reduced operational complexity, accelerated release decisions, and strengthened confidence in routine food safety control.
results: Simultaneous detection of Salmonella, E. coli O157:H7, and STEC in one PCR reaction.
One sample preparation and enrichment workflow for three critical pathogen targets.
Results available in less than 24 hours to support faster release decisions.
Reduced laboratory burden by consolidating three separate pathogen tests into one workflow.
Improved decision-making for perishable products with shorter commercial windows.

About.title: Hi, we're TAAG.
About.intro: We help organizations manage microbiological risk through advanced molecular solutions and intelligent systems.
About.story1: Founded in 2001, TAAG began as a highly specialized testing laboratory. Over the years, we steadily expanded our footprint, establishing operations across the United States, Belgium, Mexico, and Chile.
About.story2: As the global demand for faster, more precise, and scalable diagnostics grew, we recognized the need to push beyond the boundaries of traditional service models.
About.story3: This realization drove our transformation from a regional service provider into a technology-driven biotechnology organization, seamlessly integrating expert laboratory services, advanced kit manufacturing, and software development into our core operations.
About.story4: Today, our focus is firmly on advancing the standard of diagnostics. We design, manufacture, and distribute cutting-edge molecular solutions that empower our own hubs and a growing worldwide network of partner laboratories.
About.mission: Make advanced biological testing accessible to every laboratory and organization, revolutionizing how biological entities are detected, identified, and managed.
About.vision: To build a future where biological testing is fast, automated, predictive, and universally accessible, enabling every organization to protect health, optimize production, and unlock the full potential of biotechnology.

values.title: Embrace honesty
values.description: Transparency builds trust. We communicate openly with our clients, partners, and each other. We don't hide behind jargon; we present data and facts exactly as they are. Absolute honesty is the foundation of our scientific rigor.

values.title: Push the boundaries
values.description: Innovation is in our DNA. We are constantly exploring new technologies and methodologies to solve complex microbiological challenges that others consider impossible. We don't just follow the standard; we invent what comes next.

values.title: Be world-class
values.description: We are hyper-focused on doing better, and being better, at every single thing we do. We don't settle for good enough when it comes to protecting global food safety and health. If we want to be known for excellence, we must embody it daily.

values.title: Never settle
values.description: Continuous improvement drives us forward. We believe that no matter how advanced our current solutions are, there is always room to optimize, accelerate, and refine. We challenge the status quo to deliver faster and more accurate results.

values.title: Team over titles
values.description: Hard work and a collaborative spirit matter more than hierarchy. Everyone plays a uniquely important role. Our impact is maximized when we roll up our sleeves, support each other, and put the team first.

values.title: Fail forward
values.description: Operating at the cutting edge of biotechnology means taking risks. We are unafraid to make mistakes, provided we own them, learn from them, and iterate quickly. Every failure is just data that helps us build a stronger, smarter solution.

Summary.problemBodyA: Global food manufacturers often outsource environmental monitoring to third-party labs, incurring lead times of 48-72 hours and significant per-sample fees.
Summary.problemBodyB: This reactive approach means surfaces are often reused before results are known, increasing the risk and creating a critical bottleneck in production.
Summary.transformationBody: By adopting Elevia kits powered by AiGOR in-house, facilities can leverage ultra-sensitive RNA amplification to detect pathogens like Salmonella spp. directly on site, in just 3 hours and without enrichment.

Features.body: An important feature of TxA is the digitalization of your food plant. This allows TxA algorithms to identify contaminated points in your plant and automatically define the best next sampling points to track contamination sources.

items.1: TxA performs a true digitalization of your plant layout, accurately determining equipment, distances, and zones. This spatial awareness is key for our AI algorithms.
items.2: Predictive Sampling. AI algorithms analyze historical data to pinpoint the best sampling locations, preventing risks before they arise.
items.3: Power your fieldwork with the TxA App. Perform digital sampling with attached photos, detailed point information, and instant cloud syncing.
items.4: TxA maps every data point directly into context of your plant, speeding up root-cause analysis and decision making.
items.5: TxA allows you to build dynamic, preventive programs that adapt in real time to maximize food quality and safety.

app.title: TxA APP
app.intro: Transform your field sampling with our intelligent mobile application. Digitize your entire process for total control and end-to-end traceability from the field directly to the lab.

features.title: Digital Field Sampling
features.text: Replace paper logs and manual data entry with a streamlined digital workflow. Capture photos, detailed data, and the exact sampling point automatically. Track every sample's journey with immutable digital logs, ensuring 100% compliance and complete visibility over your operations.

features.title: All information in one click
features.text: Once you select the sampling point, you can add important information such as a picture from the site, laboratory analyses, sanitization status, and more.

features.title: A flawless tracking system
features.text: If you use our TAAG S11 NeutroSampling kit to perform environmental swabbing, you can automatically link all digital information with the sample by scanning the QR code printed on TAAG S11 NeutroSampling swabs.

lab.title: TxA LAB
lab.intro: Streamline your workflows and automate process controls to guarantee error-free, fully confident laboratory results every single time.

features.title: Use it for any test... even your own developed test
features.text: TxA Lab allows you to create and edit as many assays as you need, including different specialties such as microbiology testing, chemical testing, or any other test you need to add.

features.title: Detailed information means better corrective actions
features.text: Add all the fields you want to your samples in order to get all the information you need to apply the best corrective actions.

features.title: Meet your new and better laboratory report
features.text: Add the specific information you want to show in your reports to inform and share your laboratory results.

qa.title: TxA QA
qa.intro: Leverage predictive microbiology to anticipate risks and ensure comprehensive, proactive quality management across your entire facility.

features.title: In-depth analysis to maximize food quality and safety
features.text: This platform is all about microbiological food safety management. Easily analyze your laboratory results, statistics, warnings, smart and dynamic corrective action proposals, and much more.

features.title: Real-time warnings for fast corrective actions
features.text: In the notification panel, you get alerts with detailed information about positive results found in your plant. When positives appear, TxA proposes an automated, dynamic, and smart corrective action.

features.title: A new and better way of seeing microbiology
